entities.summary: Al-Farouq Ajadi Aminu is a Nigerian-American former professional basketball player who last played for the Chicago Bulls of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He also represented the Nigeria national basketball team internationally. Aminu was selected by the Los Angeles Clippers in the 2010 NBA draft with the eighth overall pick, and has also played for the New Orleans Pelicans, Dallas Mavericks, Portland Trail Blazers, and Orlando Magic.
